get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying certain properties, associations, and whether to include archived records. This endpoint supports pagination through the use of a cursor token.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

values.description: An array of strings representing multiple values for the filter. This is used with operators like 'IN' or 'NOT_IN' to match any of the specified values.

objectWriteTraceId.description: A string used for tracing the write operations on this object.

sourceType.description: A string indicating the type of source from which the value originated. This property is required.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the value was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: An integer representing the ID of the user who last updated the value.

value.description: The value associated with the timestamp. This is a string representing the data that was recorded.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to arrays of historical values, each with a timestamp and source information.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: A string representing the URL of this object.

warnings.description: An array of warnings associated with this object, each containing a category, message, and context.

category.description: A string indicating the category of the warning.

context.description: An object providing additional context about the warning, with string properties.

message.description: A string containing the warning message.

items.description: Represents a warning message related to a public object in HubSpot, providing details about the nature and context of the warning.

get.description: List all associations of a specified object by its type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a given object, identified by its type and ID, with another specified object type. The maximum number of results per call is limited to 500.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to which associations are being listed.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token used as a cursor to fetch the next page of results.

link.description: A string containing the URL link to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an association with a label. Each object contains details about the associated object and the types of associations.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications, each including a label. These define the types of associations between the objects.

category.description: A string representing the category of the association. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', and 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the object type from which the association originates.

label.description: A string that provides an optional label for the association, allowing for user-defined descriptions.

toObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the object type to which the association points.

typeId.description: An integer that uniquely identifies the type of association.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to which associations are being made. It is a string.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
